FINDINGS:
Heart size is mildly to moderately enlarged. Distal tip of dual-lumen catheter is near the caval atrial junction. Mild vascular cephalization is noted. No definite interstitial changes of pulmonary edema, focal alveolar consolidation, pleural effusion, or pneumothorax.
IMPRESSION:
1. Mild to moderate cardiomegaly. 2. Vascular redistribution without definite findings of pulmonary edema.
